_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for Claude model IDs (MODL-01 currency, MODL-06 centralization). Every runtime — gsd-memory.cjs, memory_classifier.py, amauta-daemon.py — resolves model aliases through THIS file. When a tier ships a newer version, update its id here ONCE and every caller picks it up. Do NOT scatter claude-* literals anywhere else.

notes.fable: Fable 5 — latest creative-tier model. Used when routed explicitly; degrades to the latest Opus (see fallback.fable) when unavailable (no access / model-not-found). Toggle availability with GSD_FABLE_AVAILABLE=0.
notes.opus: Opus 4.8 — latest flagship / Fable fallback target.
notes.sonnet: Sonnet 5 — latest balanced reasoning tier (R/P/E default).
